```{r ml-warning-2y-sample}
# ---- Merge t+1 and t+2 crash labels into a single two-year outcome ----
ml_warning_panel_2y <- warning_feature_panel_2y %>%
  left_join(crash_label_t1, by = c("symbol", "window_start_year")) %>%
  left_join(crash_label_t2, by = c("symbol", "window_end_year")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(snapshot_numeric_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(as.character(.x)))),
    across(all_of(edgar_numeric_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(as.character(.x)))),
    across(all_of(price_feature_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(as.character(.x)))),
    ncskew_t1 = suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(as.character(ncskew_t1))),
    ncskew_t2 = suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(as.character(ncskew_t2))),
    crash_t1 = as.integer(crash_t1),
    crash_t2 = as.integer(crash_t2)
  )

for (feature_name in snapshot_numeric_cols) {
  ml_warning_panel_2y[[paste0(feature_name, "_is_missing")]] <- as.integer(is.na(ml_warning_panel_2y[[feature_name]]))
}

for (feature_name in edgar_numeric_cols) {
  ml_warning_panel_2y[[paste0(feature_name, "_is_missing")]] <- as.integer(is.na(ml_warning_panel_2y[[feature_name]]))
}

ml_warning_panel_2y <- ml_warning_panel_2y %>%
  mutate(
    window_complete = !is.na(crash_t1) & !is.na(crash_t2),
    future_2y_crash_dummy = if_else(
      window_complete,
      as.integer(crash_t1 == 1L | crash_t2 == 1L),
      NA_integer_
    ),
    data_split = case_when(
      feature_year >= START_YEAR & feature_year <= (END_YEAR - 1L) ~ "pre_external_training_pool",
      feature_year == END_YEAR ~ "external_2024_2025_test",
      TRUE ~ "unused"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(feature_year >= START_YEAR, window_end_year <= WARNING_EXTERNAL_END_YEAR)

training_pool <- ml_warning_panel_2y %>%
  filter(
    eligible_by_year,
    window_complete,
    data_split == "pre_external_training_pool"
  )

external_test_pool <- ml_warning_panel_2y %>%
  filter(
    eligible_by_year,
    window_complete,
    feature_year == END_YEAR,
    data_split == "external_2024_2025_test"
  )

data.table::fwrite(ml_warning_panel_2y, DERIVED_ML_FILES$ml_panel)
data.table::fwrite(training_pool, OUTPUT_ML_FILES$training_panel)

tibble(
  sample_name = c("training_pool_2y", "external_test_pool_2y"),
  rows = c(nrow(training_pool), nrow(external_test_pool)),
  companies = c(dplyr::n_distinct(training_pool$symbol), dplyr::n_distinct(external_test_pool$symbol)),
  positive_rate = c(mean(training_pool$future_2y_crash_dummy, na.rm = TRUE), mean(external_test_pool$future_2y_crash_dummy, na.rm = TRUE)),
  feature_year_span = c(
    paste(range(training_pool$feature_year, na.rm = TRUE), collapse = "-"),
    paste(range(external_test_pool$feature_year, na.rm = TRUE), collapse = "-")
  ),
  window_span = c(
    paste0(min(training_pool$window_start_year, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(training_pool$window_end_year, na.rm = TRUE)),
    paste0(min(external_test_pool$window_start_year, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(external_test_pool$window_end_year, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)
```

### Two-Year Model Training and Threshold Selection

Training uses **feature-year CV** (2018-2022): models train on earlier feature years
and validate on each holdout feature year. This differs from the one-year setup
(target-year CV) because each feature year's validation window spans two future years,
making target-year splits less clean.

The same 6 model specifications (3 feature sets × 2 algorithms) are reused so
one-year and two-year results are directly comparable.

```{r ml-warning-2y-training}
snapshot_missing_flags <- paste0(snapshot_numeric_cols, "_is_missing")
edgar_missing_flags <- paste0(edgar_numeric_cols, "_is_missing")

# ---- Mirror the one-year specifications (same feature sets, same algorithms) ----
model_specifications <- tibble(
  feature_set_id = c("price_baseline", "price_plus_snapshot_esg", "price_plus_full_esg"),
  feature_set_label = c("Price Baseline", "Price + Snapshot ESG", "Price + Full ESG"),
  feature_columns = list(
    price_feature_cols,
    c(price_feature_cols, "snapshot_available", snapshot_numeric_cols, snapshot_missing_flags),
    c(price_feature_cols, "snapshot_available", snapshot_numeric_cols, snapshot_missing_flags, "edgar_available", edgar_numeric_cols, edgar_missing_flags)
  ),
  binary_columns = list(
    character(),
    c("snapshot_available", snapshot_missing_flags),
    c("snapshot_available", snapshot_missing_flags, "edgar_available", edgar_missing_flags)
  )
) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(
    tibble(
      model_type = c("weighted_logistic", "ranger_probability_forest"),
      model_label = c("Weighted Logistic", "Probability Random Forest")
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model_key = paste(feature_set_id, model_type, sep = "__"),
    model_display = paste(feature_set_label, model_label, sep = " | ")
  )

# ---- Feature-year CV: validate on 2018-2022 features, reserve 2023 for external test ----
validation_feature_years <- 2018:2022
threshold_grid <- seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.01)

validation_fold_results <- list()
validation_threshold_results <- list()

for (spec_index in seq_len(nrow(model_specifications))) {
  one_spec <- model_specifications[spec_index, ]
  feature_columns <- one_spec$feature_columns[[1]]
  binary_columns <- one_spec$binary_columns[[1]]

  for (one_validation_feature_year in validation_feature_years) {
    train_fold <- training_pool %>%
      filter(feature_year < one_validation_feature_year)

    valid_fold <- training_pool %>%
      filter(feature_year == one_validation_feature_year)

    if (nrow(train_fold) == 0 || nrow(valid_fold) == 0) {
      next
    }

    fitted_output <- if (one_spec$model_type[[1]] == "weighted_logistic") {
      fit_weighted_logistic_model_target(
        train_data = train_fold,
        apply_data = valid_fold,
        feature_cols = feature_columns,
        target_col = "future_2y_crash_dummy",
        binary_features = binary_columns
      )
    } else {
      fit_ranger_probability_model_target(
        train_data = train_fold,
        apply_data = valid_fold,
        feature_cols = feature_columns,
        target_col = "future_2y_crash_dummy",
        binary_features = binary_columns
      )
    }

    if (is.null(fitted_output)) {
      next
    }

    fold_prediction <- valid_fold %>%
      transmute(
        model_key = one_spec$model_key[[1]],
        model_display = one_spec$model_display[[1]],
        feature_set_id = one_spec$feature_set_id[[1]],
        feature_set_label = one_spec$feature_set_label[[1]],
        model_type = one_spec$model_type[[1]],
        model_label = one_spec$model_label[[1]],
        validation_feature_year = one_validation_feature_year,
        validation_window = paste0(window_start_year, "-", window_end_year),
        symbol,
        company_name,
        actual_label = future_2y_crash_dummy,
        crash_t1,
        crash_t2,
        risk_probability = fitted_output$probability
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        risk_rank = min_rank(desc(risk_probability))
      )

    fold_metrics <- calc_classification_metrics(
      actual = fold_prediction$actual_label,
      probability = fold_prediction$risk_probability,
      threshold = 0.50
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        model_key = one_spec$model_key[[1]],
        model_display = one_spec$model_display[[1]],
        feature_set_id = one_spec$feature_set_id[[1]],
        feature_set_label = one_spec$feature_set_label[[1]],
        model_type = one_spec$model_type[[1]],
        model_label = one_spec$model_label[[1]],
        validation_feature_year = one_validation_feature_year,
        validation_window = paste0(min(valid_fold$window_start_year), "-", max(valid_fold$window_end_year)),
        train_rows = nrow(train_fold),
        validation_rows = nrow(valid_fold),
        train_positive_rate = mean(train_fold$future_2y_crash_dummy, na.rm = TRUE),
        validation_positive_rate = mean(valid_fold$future_2y_crash_dummy, na.rm = TRUE)
      )

    threshold_metrics <- build_threshold_metrics(
      actual = fold_prediction$actual_label,
      probability = fold_prediction$risk_probability,
      thresholds = threshold_grid
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        model_key = one_spec$model_key[[1]],
        model_display = one_spec$model_display[[1]],
        feature_set_id = one_spec$feature_set_id[[1]],
        feature_set_label = one_spec$feature_set_label[[1]],
        model_type = one_spec$model_type[[1]],
        model_label = one_spec$model_label[[1]],
        validation_feature_year = one_validation_feature_year
      )

    validation_fold_results[[length(validation_fold_results) + 1]] <- fold_metrics
    validation_threshold_results[[length(validation_threshold_results) + 1]] <- threshold_metrics
  }
}

validation_fold_metrics <- bind_rows(validation_fold_results)
validation_threshold_metrics <- bind_rows(validation_threshold_results)

threshold_selection <- validation_threshold_metrics %>%
  group_by(model_key, model_display, feature_set_id, feature_set_label, model_type, model_label, threshold) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_balanced_accuracy = mean(balanced_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_precision = mean(precision, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_recall = mean(recall, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_f0_5 = mean(f0_5, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pr_auc_proxy = mean(pr_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(model_key, model_display, feature_set_id, feature_set_label, model_type, model_label) %>%
  group_modify(~ choose_threshold_from_validation(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(selected_threshold = threshold)

cv_model_comparison <- validation_fold_metrics %>%
  group_by(model_key, model_display, feature_set_id, feature_set_label, model_type, model_label) %>%
  summarise(
    fold_count = n(),
    mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_balanced_accuracy = mean(balanced_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_precision = mean(precision, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_recall = mean(recall, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_f0_5 = mean(f0_5, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_roc_auc = mean(roc_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pr_auc = mean(pr_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_precision_at_top10 = mean(precision_at_top10, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_top20_hit_rate = mean(top20_hit_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_train_positive_rate = mean(train_positive_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_validation_positive_rate = mean(validation_positive_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    threshold_selection %>%
      select(model_key, selected_threshold, mean_accuracy, mean_balanced_accuracy, mean_precision, mean_recall, mean_f0_5),
    by = "model_key",
    suffix = c("_cv", "_threshold")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_pr_auc), desc(mean_precision_at_top10), desc(mean_f0_5_cv), desc(mean_accuracy_cv), model_type)

best_overall_model <- cv_model_comparison %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_pr_auc), desc(mean_precision_at_top10), desc(mean_f0_5_cv), desc(mean_accuracy_cv), model_type) %>%
  slice(1)

best_logistic_model <- cv_model_comparison %>%
  filter(model_type == "weighted_logistic") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_pr_auc), desc(mean_precision_at_top10), desc(mean_f0_5_cv), desc(mean_accuracy_cv)) %>%
  slice(1)

best_forest_model <- cv_model_comparison %>%
  filter(model_type == "ranger_probability_forest") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_pr_auc), desc(mean_precision_at_top10), desc(mean_f0_5_cv), desc(mean_accuracy_cv)) %>%
  slice(1)

data.table::fwrite(validation_fold_metrics, OUTPUT_ML_FILES$validation_fold_metrics)
data.table::fwrite(validation_threshold_metrics, OUTPUT_ML_FILES$threshold_tuning)
data.table::fwrite(cv_model_comparison, OUTPUT_ML_FILES$cv_model_comparison)

cv_model_comparison %>%
  select(model_display, mean_pr_auc, mean_precision_at_top10, mean_f0_5_cv, mean_accuracy_cv, selected_threshold) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)
```

### 2024-2025 Two-Year External Validation and Warning Outputs

The two-year external test uses 2023 features to predict crashes in the 2024-2025
window. Since 2025 crash labels are now realized, this provides an additional
out-of-sample check beyond the one-year 2024-only test.

Additional outputs vs. one-year:
- Confusion matrices (all models + champion only)
- Accuracy/precision/recall/F0.5 comparison bar chart
- Two-year champion model's top-20 high-risk company list

```{r ml-warning-2y-external-validation}
external_prediction_results <- list()
logistic_coefficient_tables <- list()
forest_importance_tables <- list()
pr_curve_tables <- list()

for (spec_index in seq_len(nrow(model_specifications))) {
  one_spec <- model_specifications[spec_index, ]
  feature_columns <- one_spec$feature_columns[[1]]
  binary_columns <- one_spec$binary_columns[[1]]

  fitted_output <- if (one_spec$model_type[[1]] == "weighted_logistic") {
    fit_weighted_logistic_model_target(
      train_data = training_pool,
      apply_data = external_test_pool,
      feature_cols = feature_columns,
      target_col = "future_2y_crash_dummy",
      binary_features = binary_columns
    )
  } else {
    fit_ranger_probability_model_target(
      train_data = training_pool,
      apply_data = external_test_pool,
      feature_cols = feature_columns,
      target_col = "future_2y_crash_dummy",
      binary_features = binary_columns
    )
  }

  if (is.null(fitted_output)) {
    next
  }

  final_threshold <- threshold_selection %>%
    filter(model_key == one_spec$model_key[[1]]) %>%
    pull(selected_threshold)

  if (length(final_threshold) == 0 || is.na(final_threshold[[1]])) {
    final_threshold <- 0.5
  } else {
    final_threshold <- final_threshold[[1]]
  }

  final_prediction <- external_test_pool %>%
    transmute(
      model_key = one_spec$model_key[[1]],
      model_display = one_spec$model_display[[1]],
      feature_set_id = one_spec$feature_set_id[[1]],
      feature_set_label = one_spec$feature_set_label[[1]],
      model_type = one_spec$model_type[[1]],
      model_label = one_spec$model_label[[1]],
      symbol,
      company_name,
      sector_standardized,
      feature_year,
      window_start_year,
      window_end_year,
      crash_t1,
      crash_t2,
      ncskew_t1,
      ncskew_t2,
      future_2y_crash_dummy,
      risk_probability = fitted_output$probability
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      selected_threshold = final_threshold,
      warning_flag = risk_probability >= selected_threshold,
      risk_rank = min_rank(desc(risk_probability))
    )

  external_prediction_results[[length(external_prediction_results) + 1]] <- final_prediction

  if (!is.null(fitted_output$coefficient_table)) {
    logistic_coefficient_tables[[one_spec$model_key[[1]]]] <- fitted_output$coefficient_table %>%
      mutate(
        model_key = one_spec$model_key[[1]],
        model_display = one_spec$model_display[[1]]
      )
  }

  if (!is.null(fitted_output$importance_table)) {
    forest_importance_tables[[one_spec$model_key[[1]]]] <- fitted_output$importance_table %>%
      mutate(
        model_key = one_spec$model_key[[1]],
        model_display = one_spec$model_display[[1]]
      )
  }

  pr_curve_tables[[one_spec$model_key[[1]]]] <- build_pr_curve_data(
    actual = final_prediction$future_2y_crash_dummy,
    probability = final_prediction$risk_probability,
    model_label = one_spec$model_display[[1]]
  )
}

external_predictions <- bind_rows(external_prediction_results)
logistic_coefficients_all <- bind_rows(logistic_coefficient_tables)
forest_importance_all <- bind_rows(forest_importance_tables)
pr_curve_2y <- bind_rows(pr_curve_tables)

external_test_metrics <- external_predictions %>%
  group_by(model_key, model_display, feature_set_id, feature_set_label, model_type, model_label) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    threshold_value <- unique(.x$selected_threshold)[1]
    calc_classification_metrics(.x$future_2y_crash_dummy, .x$risk_probability, threshold = threshold_value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(pr_auc), desc(precision_at_top10), desc(f0_5), desc(accuracy))

confusion_matrix_by_model <- external_predictions %>%
  group_by(model_key, model_display, feature_set_id, feature_set_label, model_type, model_label) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    threshold_value <- unique(.x$selected_threshold)[1]
    build_confusion_matrix_table(.x$future_2y_crash_dummy, .x$risk_probability, threshold = threshold_value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

champion_model_key <- best_overall_model$model_key[[1]]
champion_predictions <- external_predictions %>%

champion_model_label <- if (nrow(champion_predictions) > 0) champion_predictions$model_display[[1]] else "No model available"

)

    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2F6DB3", "FALSE" = "#D95F02")) +
    labs(
      title = "Best Logistic Model Coefficients (2-Year Warning)",
      subtitle = best_logistic_label,
      x = "Feature",
      y = "Coefficient Estimate"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
} else {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = 1, label = "No logistic coefficients available") +
    labs(title = "Best Logistic Model Coefficients (2-Year Warning)") +
    theme_void()
}

best_forest_key <- if (nrow(best_forest_model) > 0) best_forest_model$model_key[[1]] else NA_character_
best_forest_label <- if (nrow(best_forest_model) > 0) best_forest_model$model_display[[1]] else "No forest model available"

best_forest_importance <- forest_importance_all %>%
  filter(model_key == best_forest_key) %>%
  slice_max(importance, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(importance) %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = term))

forest_importance_plot <- if (nrow(best_forest_importance) > 0) {
  best_forest_importance %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = term, y = importance)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2F6DB3", width = 0.75) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "Best Probability Forest Feature Importance (2-Year Warning)",
      subtitle = best_forest_label,
      x = "Feature",
      y = "Importance"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
} else {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = 1, label = "No forest importance available") +
    labs(title = "Best Probability Forest Feature Importance (2-Year Warning)") +
    theme_void()
}

ggplot2::ggsave(OUTPUT_ML_FILES$pr_curve, pr_curve_plot, width = 9.5, height = 6.2, dpi = 160)
ggplot2::ggsave(OUTPUT_ML_FILES$accuracy_precision_plot, accuracy_precision_plot, width = 10.5, height = 6.8, dpi = 160)
ggplot2::ggsave(OUTPUT_ML_FILES$confusion_all_plot, confusion_matrix_all_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 160)
ggplot2::ggsave(OUTPUT_ML_FILES$confusion_champion_plot, champion_confusion_plot, width = 7.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 160)
ggplot2::ggsave(OUTPUT_ML_FILES$top_risk_plot, top_risk_plot, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 160)
ggplot2::ggsave(OUTPUT_ML_FILES$logistic_coef_plot, logistic_coef_plot, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 160)
ggplot2::ggsave(OUTPUT_ML_FILES$forest_importance_plot, forest_importance_plot, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 160)

external_test_metrics %>%
  select(model_display, pr_auc, roc_auc, accuracy, balanced_accuracy, precision, recall, f0_5, precision_at_top10, top20_hit_rate, selected_threshold) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)

esg_gain_summary %>% knitr::kable(digits = 4)
```

### Two-Year Machine Learning Validation Checks

Assert invariants for the two-year setup:
- Window boundaries align correctly with feature years
- Training pool excludes realized 2025 labels
- 2-year label exactly equals crash_t1 | crash_t2
- Confusion matrix cell counts sum to evaluation sample size

```{r ml-warning-2y-validation}
# ---- Verify two-year temporal alignment ----
stopifnot(all(training_pool$window_start_year == training_pool$feature_year + 1L))
stopifnot(all(training_pool$window_end_year == training_pool$feature_year + WARNING_LOOKAHEAD_YEARS))
stopifnot(!any(training_pool$window_end_year == WARNING_EXTERNAL_END_YEAR))
stopifnot(all(external_test_pool$feature_year == END_YEAR))
stopifnot(all(external_test_pool$window_start_year == WARNING_EXTERNAL_START_YEAR))
stopifnot(all(external_test_pool$window_end_year == WARNING_EXTERNAL_END_YEAR))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(training_pool$future_2y_crash_dummy)))
stopifnot(all(
  ml_warning_panel_2y$future_2y_crash_dummy[ml_warning_panel_2y$window_complete] ==
    as.integer(
      ml_warning_panel_2y$crash_t1[ml_warning_panel_2y$window_complete] == 1L |
        ml_warning_panel_2y$crash_t2[ml_warning_panel_2y$window_complete] == 1L
    )
))
stopifnot(nrow(external_test_metrics) == nrow(model_specifications))
stopifnot(all(external_test_metrics$selected_threshold >= 0.05 & external_test_metrics$selected_threshold <= 0.95))
stopifnot(all(external_test_metrics$accuracy >= 0 & external_test_metrics$accuracy <= 1))
stopifnot(all(external_test_metrics$balanced_accuracy[!is.na(external_test_metrics$balanced_accuracy)] >= 0 & external_test_metrics$balanced_accuracy[!is.na(external_test_metrics$balanced_accuracy)] <= 1))
stopifnot(all(external_test_metrics$pr_auc[!is.na(external_test_metrics$pr_auc)] >= 0 & external_test_metrics$pr_auc[!is.na(external_test_metrics$pr_auc)] <= 1))
stopifnot(all(external_test_metrics$roc_auc[!is.na(external_test_metrics$roc_auc)] >= 0 & external_test_metrics$roc_auc[!is.na(external_test_metrics$roc_auc)] <= 1))
stopifnot(all(external_predictions$risk_rank >= 1))

confusion_validation <- confusion_matrix_by_model %>%
  group_by(model_key) %>%
  summarise(total_count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(external_test_metrics %>% select(model_key, n_eval), by = "model_key")

stopifnot(all(confusion_validation$total_count == confusion_validation$n_eval))

ml_validation_summary_2y <- tibble(
  check = c(
    "window_start_year always equals feature_year + 1",
    "window_end_year always equals feature_year + 2",
    "Training pool excludes realized 2025 labels",
    "External test uses 2023 features and validates 2024-2025",
    "The 2-year label equals a crash in either of the next two years",
    "Accuracy / Balanced Accuracy / PR AUC / ROC AUC lie within [0, 1]",
    "Confusion matrix cells sum to the external test sample size"
  ),
  result = "PASS"
)

knitr::kable(ml_validation_summary_2y)
```
